title: Bishkek mamlekettik universityine AKShnyn Tynchtyk Korpusunun өkүldөrү ish sapary menen kelishti

blocks.text: 2025-zhildyn 28-yulunda K. Karasaev atyndagy Bishkek mamlekettik universityine AKShnyn Tynchtyk Korpusunun Kyrgyz Republicsyndagy Aimaktyk zhetekchisi Asel Saparbaeva zhana Monitoring zhana baaloo adisi Tolgonay Sopukeeva ish sapary menen kelishti. Sapardyn alkagynda alar university zhamaatyn zhany yktyyarchy Kain Bishoptu taanyshtyryp ketishti.

Tynchtyk Korpusunun өkүldөrun university rector, professor Mirlan Dyldaev, El aralyk kyzmattashuu zhana investment departmentin director Edil Kanatbekov, el aralyk bilim beru programlar zhana dolboorlor boyuncha coordinator Rakhat Rai kyzy, oshondoy ele yktyyarchynyn Counterparts Zhanybek Bazarbayev tosup alyshty.

Zholugushuuda yktyyarkhyny zhyluu kabyl aluu menen birge, aldynky ailarda studentter zhana professorduk-okutuuchular kurama menen eco-tourism bagytynda ish alyp baruu boyuncha plandar talkuulandy. Ish sapar dostuk maanaida өtup, taraptar Tynchtyk Korpus menen bolgon kyzmattashtykty myndan ary da terendetuugo kyzyktar ekendigin bildirishti.
